beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: Shanghai compresses schedule, factory-city, social image, cloud runway, buyer order, product identity and distributed memory into synchronized platform time. This chapter follows circulation: A public stream can widen technical access while ranking systems, language, bandwidth and platform ownership continue to govern attention.
beats.onScreen: Then: Alibaba’s first-party record says the March 2020 edition moved online through Tmall as a response to COVID-19, with livestreamed presentations and commercial features.

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: Alibaba’s first-party record says the March 2020 edition moved online through Tmall as a response to COVID-19, with livestreamed presentations and commercial features. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: Tmall’s commerce infrastructure joined presentation and transaction, but the company account is not independent proof of audience quality, neutrality or long-term preservation.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
beats.onScreen: Next: No permanent future cloud, streaming or commerce supplier stack is inferred from the 2020 partnership.
